metadata.case_name: XU XINHONG v. CHEUNG CHU LAU

injuries.description: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) of her cervical spine was done, showing central disc herniation from C3 to C6 causing mild to moderate cord compression. C5/6 level is most severly affected.
source: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) of her cervical spine was done, showing central disc herniation from C3 to C6 causing mild to moderate cord compression. C5/6 level is most severly affected.
Magnetic resonance of the cervical spine was performed on 18/10/2012, showing central disc herniation is noted with cord compression.
We performed anterior discectomy and fusion of the cervical spine on 3/4/2013.
injuries.icd_description: Central cord syndrome of cervical spinal cord

injuries.description: Chest wall injury (tenderness over right chest wall as recorded in A&E).
source: The chief complaint was neck, chest wall and right leg injury.
There was tenderness over her cervical spine, right chest wall and right leg.

injuries.description: Right leg injury (tenderness over right leg; no fracture on X-ray).
source: The chief complaint was neck, chest wall and right leg injury.
There was tenderness over her cervical spine, right chest wall and right leg.
X-rays of her ribs, cervical spine, pelvis and right elbow did not reveal any fracture.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified parts of lower leg

source: She went through an operation on her neck, leaving a scar affecting her appearance/self-esteem.
The scar has undoubtedly caused suffering and loss of amenity to her life.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the neck

manifestations.description: Neck pain (on and off attack of neck pain and stiffness)
Neck stiffness and reduced range of neck movement
Numbness over her right arm / right upper limb numbness
Decreased sensation in the right upper limb (and left upper limb findings noted)
Reduced right upper limb power (reported decreased right sided power initially)
Mild impaired sensation over C5/6 dermatome levels
Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and Moderate depressive episode
Anxiety about traffic and fear of driving; avoidance of stimuli associated with the accident
Poor sleep, low mood with crying spells, increased eating with weight gain, loss of libido, loss of interest and energy, some sense of worthlessness, fleeting suicidal idea

treatments_received: Anterior cervical discectomy and fusion of the cervical spine (3/4/2013)
treatments_future: Further psychiatric treatment and treatment by a clinical psychologist (estimated at least three more years as per expert opinion)
Possible behavioural therapy (systematic desensitisation) and referral to Rehab-aid centre for simulated driving sessions

losses.description: Scar on neck from operation affecting appearance/self-esteem and causing suffering and loss of amenity.
Plaintiff cannot resume the pre-accident job as a taxi-driver and has suffered loss of earning capacity.
Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and Moderate depressive episode Anxiety about traffic and fear of driving; avoidance of stimuli associated with the accident

comparable_cases.case_name: Suen Kum Fung Kandy v Tsang Cham Kuen & Anor
comparable_cases.injury_description: Whiplash injury in a car accident. P had residual persistent neck pain. She had then developed psychiatric symptoms that brought about a character and personality change. The symptoms affected the marital relationship and her husband divorced her. PSLA of $500,000.
